neighbours.label: a word that sets which items an average covers (trimmed mean, included, excluded, 'red, blue, and green')
fire: If the two lowest scores are excluded, the class average rises to 84.
The average age of the players, coaches, and referees was 31 years.
When the captain's salary is included, the team's mean wage doubles.
We report the trimmed mean, which drops the top and bottom five percent.
The average weight of the apples, pears, and plums in the crate was 150 g.
Excluding weekends, the average daily traffic on the bridge is 40,000 cars.
The mean rainfall, not counting the flood year, was 600 mm per year.
If the manager's age is also counted, the average age goes up by two years.
quiet: The class average on the final exam was 84 out of 100 points.
The average age on the football team this season was 31 years.
The team's mean wage is now one of the highest in the league.
We report the average score and the standard deviation in Table 2.
The apples in the crate were large, sweet, and freshly picked this week.
The average daily traffic on the bridge is about 40,000 cars.
The mean rainfall in the valley is about 600 mm per year.
The average age of the staff has risen steadily over the last decade.
